synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)

title: Ring ni Kakero
synopsis: Takane Kiku and Takane Ryuji are the children of a legendary world contender boxer. Kiku, the daughter seems to have inherited her father's boxing sense and tries to teach Ryuji to become a world contender. However, Ryuji hates boxing and gets picked on. After Kiku and Ryuji leave their hometown for Tokyo, Ryuji eventually learns to discover a passion for boxing after an encounter with a boxing prodigy, Kenzaki Jun. This will eventually lead him to learn crazy moves and out of this world opponents to become one of Japan's top junior boxers. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
titleEnglish: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
synonyms: Excuse Me for Being a Cat!
synopsis: Shiraishi Yayoi was a relatively unremarkable school girl, although a little clumsy, before a experimental accident changed her life forever. She was forced against her will by her father, self-proclaimed genius physicist, Shiraishi Sensei into a teleporter with a cat , and like in the movie "The Fly", she combined with the cat. Now, whenever she gets excited about anything, a pair of cat ears and a tail pop into existence. In the "catgirl" form, she has super powers, but the major drawback is that she also behaves like a cat when presented with the proper stimuli, like the sight of mice. She also has a boyfriend, but her "problem" tends to interfere in their dates since her excitement inevitably leads to her transformation into a catgirl. (Source: Taruby)

synonyms: Even if it's not my turn
Even If You’re Not My Mate
synopsis: In a world where humans are Betas and beastmen are divided into Alphas and Omegas, beastmen live among the human majority by taking on human forms. Akihiko is a snow leopard beastman who seems to have everything. He is an Alpha, the heir to a powerful and wealthy family, and handsome features in his human form. Yet the people around him only care about his status. Tired of this shallow way of life, Akihiko transfers from an elite private school to a public one while keeping his beast form, hoping to find someone who will love him for who he is. Without a personal chauffeur for once, Akihiko arrives at school and is greeted by Haruyoshi aka Haru, a boy with beautiful tan skin and sharp teeth. With Haru, Akihiko experiences an ordinary crêpe for the first time, visits an arcade, and makes his very first friend. As their friendship grows, so do Akihiko's feelings for Haru...

title: Ruri no Houseki
synopsis: Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt! Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy! (Source: Harta, translated)
